svg.title: Dreams function review by game system
svg.desc: 260 of 9570 function names checked. 1703 functions have evidence-backed system assignments; 7867 functions do not. Sections show evidence-backed associations with parts of Dreams. Every square is a real function. All function squares share one continuous lattice. Nested section outlines identify ownership. Labels overlay their own cells; only the final row may be incomplete. Green means an evidence-supported descriptive name checked against static code; amber means reviewed but unclear; gray means not reviewed. This does not measure runtime testing or feature completion. Assignments are incomplete; full system totals and completion are unknown.

g.text: Section counts = checked names / identified functions
Static code review only: no in-game verification claimed. 7,867 functions still unmapped.
